name: Leaderboard
description: Show game scores or automatic Run Progress best times on a 3D panel or themed screen overlay.

changelog.notes: The on-screen board takes its place in the shared HUD layout, so it no longer overlaps other HUDs, and shows the top 5 on phones, whose screen is a third shorter.

Before the first score the board tells players "No scores yet — be the first!" (or "No times yet" for times) instead of setup instructions, and its text wraps to stay inside the panel. A board placed before this keeps its old text size, where the new line already fits.
The 3D panel's text is readable from its front, and players can no longer walk through the board. A board placed before this keeps its old text position and no collider: delete it and place it again.
Rows show the display name of players in the scene, or a name the row carries; others show a short address.

Initial release: a panel that reads the game.state key you name in boardKey and paints its top rows, so the board a Script keeps is the board every player sees and a late joiner gets it from the snapshot.
The placed panel's Script card now shows the setState line that writes the rows it paints, under its own settings.
Themed screen overlay and automatic persisted best times from Run Progress.
